security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU implements the SCTRCLR instruction but fails to bound the write loop by the hardware-WARL-limited sctrdepth.DEPTH value, allowing writes through siselect/sireg indirect CSR aliasing to indices beyond the physically implemented CTR buffer entries (max depth 16 << WARL_DEPTH_max). Additionally, if QEMU omits clearing the internal CTR_CYCLE_COUNTER and CCV_HW state on SCTRCLR execution, a subsequent ctrdata read exposes stale control-flow history (source/target PC, transfer type, elapsed cycles) from a prior security context.
security_spec.summary: SCTRCLR indirect-CSR clear loop must be WARL-bounded on sctrdepth.DEPTH and must atomically zero CTR_CYCLE_COUNTER/CCV_HW, otherwise stale cross-context branch history leaks through ctrdata reads
